verdict.rationale: kitty's docs cover window/tab layouts, remote control, and shell integration, but there is no evidence of a global-hotkey/quake-style dropdown summon feature (kitty is a normal windowed terminal, not an OS-level overlay); no docs or community reports mention such a capability, and some OS integration issues are noted (e.g. xterm-kitty TERM problems) but nothing about instant-summon hotkeys.
